title: Dual Pose Blue Punk Character
description: Two side-by-side full-body illustrations of a female character with teal spiky hair and star motifs. The left pose shows her with arms crossed above her head while the right pose shows her in a fighting stance with fists raised near her face.
prompt: A young female character with short spiky teal hair, facial markings, and heterochromia, wearing a purple crop top, black cape with teal inner lining, baggy teal pants, and black boots with silver star emblems. She has fingerless gloves and a star buckle belt. Shown in two poses on a plain grey background: one with arms crossed above her head, the other in a combat stance with fists up, digital painting style with clean cel-shaded coloring.
